LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 1.3.1 WORD CLASSES

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes, part of Strand 1 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How do we use naming words in communication? 2. Why is it important to determine how a word is used in a sentence?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. collaboratively list down all the count and non-count nouns, common and proper nouns, concrete and abstract nouns from an audio or written text. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication,

2. practise replacing a common noun with a proper noun with peers, for example, “The man helped the boy...” with “Peter helped John”,

3. construct sentences featuring count and non- count nouns from a substitution table. Learners 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. collaboratively list down all the count and non-count nouns, common and proper nouns, concrete and abstract nouns from an audio or written text. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication,
2. practise replacing a common noun with a proper noun with peers, for example, “The man helped the boy...” with “Peter helped John”,
3. construct sentences featuring count and non- count nouns from a substitution table. Learners 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
16

● Communication and collaboration as the learner engage in team work to use the learnt word classes to fill in a

crossword puzzle.

● Critical thinking as the learner takes time to reflect on the distinction between the usage of words as pronouns and

determiners.

Values:
● Unity is promoted as the learner avoids discrimination as they collaboratively write a dialogue using nouns, pronouns

and determiners.

● Learning to learn is enhanced as the learner displays the ability to independently form sentences featuring phrasal

quantifiers and count and non-count nouns from a substitution table.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Life skills education as learners promotes their analytical thinking when distinguishing between the usage of words as

pronouns and determiners.

Suggested Learning Resources: Dictionaries, authentic materials such newspapers, recommended Text books, online

materials, adapted digital devices with filter keys/key guards/larger mouse/head control input devices such as head wand.

universal cuffs/wrist braces/arm braces, weighted pencil/pen
